description: This file is a controller module for aggregating and returning user and project cost data from MongoDB collections, specifically for the endpoint GET /api/llm-costs. It defines a utility function for number coercion, a main async function to fetch and process data, and exports this function.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Utility function to convert any value to a finite number, defaulting to 0 if not finite.

methods.name: getAggregatedCosts
methods.description: Controller function handling GET /api/llm-costs; fetches user and project data, processes cost fields, and returns aggregated results or error.
